title: Gloria (Gaspar, Missa brevis)
desc: Gaspar van Weerbeke, Missa brevis, Gloria. 4 voices (Superius, Altus, Tenor, Bassus), each on its own staff. From the Josquin Research Project (josquin.stanford.edu, Gas0201b), edited by Paul Kolb (Gaspar van Weerbeke: Collected Works. II. Masses, Part 2, 2018); encoded by Karina Zybina. Edition published by American Institute of Musicology. Copyright 2016, Kolb, Paul. Licence: CC BY-NC 4.0; converted to Cantare notation (tools/kern2cantare.py). Note values as in the edition (whole note = semibreve); coloured notes stand for the triplet groups; editorial accidentals small above the staff.
